statement: Meta has committed to deploying up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs across its AI infrastructure.
why: A 6 GW hyperscaler commitment is a major AMD design win and large incremental accelerator demand.

impact.mechanism: Meta's multi-gigawatt AMD commitment lifts demand for AMD merchant GPUs and associated power capacity.
